title: Fabrication and characterization of xanthan gum nanofibers reinforced with thiosemicarbazide: adsorption of Pb2+ from an aqueous medium
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37859-37870
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06364C, Paper
Open Access

Reem Ghubayra, Ibtisam Mousa, Marwah M. M. Madkhali, Abdel-Nasser M. A. Alaghaz, Asaad F. Hassan
In this study, electrospinning was used to fabricate xanthan gum (XF) and thiosemicarbazide/xanthan gum (TXF) nanofibers crosslinked with ferric ions for effective Pb2+ adsorption.
